title: Derived pullback and evaluation on coherent finite coefficient systems
statement:
Fix commutative rings $A_n$ and ring homomorphisms $\tau_n:A_{n+1}\to A_n$ in universe $u$, and schemes $X,Y$ in universe $u$. Regard $A_n$ as its constant ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site. Define the category of strict quotient-semilinear systems as module sheaves on the vertical ringed sequence site, and its ordinary unbounded derived category $D_{\rm sys}(X,A_\bullet)$; it is not a category of diagrams in individual derived categories. Define evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_n$ by restriction to the nth vertical slice and its induced derived functor. For $f:X\to Y$, use base change $(n,U)\mapsto(n,X\times_YU)$, with the constant-section coefficient map, to define sectionwise system direct image and its left adjoint $f^*_{\rm sys}$. When every $A_n$ is finite, define $F^{\rm sys}_f=D(f^*_{\rm sys})$ by the exact termwise inverse image. Its derived evaluation comparison is the localization of the ordinary evaluation comparison uniquely fixed by the inverse-image adjunction unit on generators. Its compositor is the localization of the adjunction mate of the sectionwise fibre-product-pasting comparison. All constructions retain the given horizontal coefficient maps.

Constructions used: [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-sp-varying-ring-operations].
